name: SpeechT5 TTS
notes: MIT license, commercial use allowed. Voice quality/expressiveness is more limited than newer TTS models -- adequate for a smoke-test pipeline, evaluate separately for production voice quality.

name: Coqui XTTS-v2
notes: CPML is non-commercial by default and historically required a separate commercial agreement with Coqui (the company has since shut down, so the practical path to a commercial license is unclear). Do not use in a commercial pipeline without self-verifying current licensing status. Separately, verified 2026-09-10: the actively-maintained `coqui-tts` PyPI package (0.27.5) fails to import against this project's `transformers` 5.5.0 (`ImportError: cannot import name 'isin_mps_friendly' from transformers.pytorch_utils`) -- needs an older, separately-pinned transformers version to actually run; see 07_GENERATION/audio/tts_generator.py::CoquiXTTSLocalTTSProvider docstring.

name: Bark
notes: MIT, commercial use allowed. Used by 07_GENERATION/audio/tts_generator.py's BarkLocalTTSProvider -- no API key, no cloning needed, ships with a fixed set of preset speaker voices (not your own cloned voice).

name: Bark-small
notes: MIT, commercial use allowed. Smaller/faster than full Bark at some quality cost; this is the default model_id in BarkLocalTTSProvider.
